message.content:
The archive supplied the PDF bytes, but not readable text. I’m downloading the archived capture directly and running PDF text extraction to obtain the exact volume.
```python
archive_extract = await run_command("curl -L --fail -s 'https://web.archive.org/web/20230609111516id_/https://journals.le.ac.uk/ojs1/index.php/jist/article/download/733/684' -o ./dragon_paper.pdf && pdftotext -layout ./dragon_paper.pdf -")
print(archive_extract)
```
